messages:
support_lead: FYI customer acme-corp hit repeated 502s and timeouts starting ~10:05 UTC during a traffic spike, escalated to CS. They reported ~15% error rate for /v1/generate for ~18m. Full customer panic :scream:.

csm_maya: They pasted a couple of example requests and timestamps. Net: spike at 10:04, 10:07, 10:11. They said retries didn't help. Asking for ETA.

alice_eng_oncall: Taking lead. Any recent infra or operator changes in prod last hour?

ops_bot: deploy-bot: Rolled out keda-operator v2.6.1 to prod at 09:48 UTC to a subset of clusters (canary nodes). No other infra changes.

bob_platform: That canary rollout correlates. We saw occasional ScaledObject reconciliation errors in staging with 2.6.x patch. Could be metric provider mismatch.

dan_infra: From metrics: queue_length for tenant acme-corp spiked and stayed >100 for ~12m. HPA/KEDA scale-up events triggered but new pods stayed in Init and didn't become Ready because model-init took >60s. Node allocation also delayed: several "NoNodesAvailable" events around 10:06-10:10.

carla_runtime: Runtime logs from warmstart flows show repeated model fetch timeouts when the node PVC mount retried. Sample: ```ERROR runtime: model fetch timed out after 30s, retrying (attempt 3)\nstack: model-fetch.go:142```

emma_devex: We pushed a prewarm probe cooldown tweak two days ago that reduced prewarm concurrency. Noted in the change log but might interact with KEDA warmup.

alice_eng_oncall: Can someone paste the ScaledObject describe and HPA events for the tenant? Need repro steps.

dan_infra: Attached kubectl snippets (pasted): ```kubectl describe scaledobject acme-models -n prod``` -> shows scale to 10 requested, KEDA annotated with cooldown 300s, trigger auth secret missing on a subset of pods. HPA events: "scale up limited: failed to allocate 3 pods: pod admission webhook timed out" repeated.

bob_platform: That auth secret missing is suspicious — might be an edge case in the operator rollout where the annotation parser skipped secretRef for some replicaset templates. I can roll back the operator in the canary cluster.

support_lead: CS: customer also mentions several 401s for streaming sessions earlier which then turned into 502s. Could be token rotation + scale delay.

carla_runtime: Auth rotation + missing secret would cause the freshly started pods to fail auth calls during init, stalling readiness and KV cache warmup. That explains prolonged init and then gateway 502 when requests routed to non-ready pods.

alice_eng_oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Can we pause the keda operator canary rollout to prevent further mis-parsed ScaledObjects? 2) Temporarily increase HPA minReplicas for the tenant (or pin to Dedicated capacity) to avoid relying on cold scale. 3) Ask CS to route traffic away from that tenant's prod shard if possible.

bob_platform: Paused rollout and started rollback on the canary group at 10:35 UTC. Rolling back now.

dan_infra: Increased HPA min to 3 for acme-models and created a temporary emergency prewarm job to populate KV cache. Queue is slowly draining.

ops_bot: alert: emergency-hpa-change executed by dan_infra at 10:41 UTC.

csm_maya: Let me update the customer: told them we're rolling back operator and increasing min capacity, expect recovery in ~20–30m. They asked for a postmortem and root cause.

alice_eng_oncall: Repro steps we have so far: 1) keda-operator v2.6.1 canary applied -> some ScaledObjects lose secretRef parsing 2) incoming spike causes KEDA to request scale 3) new pods start but fail prewarm/auth due to missing secret 4) readiness probes fail, model init stalls, requests routed cause 502/timeouts 5) node allocation issues amplify lag.

carla_runtime: For postmortem capture: attach runtime logs (model-fetch failures, auth error lines), kube events, ScaledObject YAML before/after, and CS request traces (request IDs). Also include recent prewarm config tweak that changed concurrency.

emma_devex: We should add an integration test for ScaledObject secretRef parsing + operator version matrix. Also revert the prewarm cooldown tweak until operator is stable.

bob_platform: I will open an urgent PR to ensure operator upgrade has a migration step that preserves secret refs and add a canary test that runs scaledobject reconcile + kube events smoke test.

support_lead: Thanks team — keep this thread updated with recovery and timeline. If we see any recurring 5xx after rollback, escalate to SEV.

alice_eng_oncall: Recovery check at 10:58 UTC: error rate dropped to ~1.2%, most pods became Ready, queue back to baseline. Marking incident as mitigated for now, but still tracking for RCA.

support_lead: Noted. We'll schedule a follow-up PM/engineering postmortem doc and include customer remediation plan.

ops_bot: incident-note: Mitigated at 10:58 UTC, rollback performed, HPA min increased, follow-up RCA required.
